lines.line: In Aero, your head is the most useful thing you own.
It starts in a sea of ones and zeros, which ripples when you touch it.
Did anyone in this network ever log out?
You log in, and then you copy yourself.
You walk along a glass path, past photos of places you may have forgotten.
You play back a memory of a lake.
Then you climb, find four memories, and roll your head into the pipe that takes you home.
At the top, you meet the cloud warden who kept the lights on.
